## 29:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Ascribe to-YHWH the-glory of-His-name; bow-down to-YHWH in-the-splendor of-holiness.
- **LOGOS:** Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness.
- **PNEUMA:** Honor the LORD for the glory of His name. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
